briefing: It slowly circles an oval over the bay. Huge HP, a long fight (when time runs out it crosses the bay and leaves)
The swarm keeps coming out of the 3 red belly nests and rams you. Break a nest to stop it. It banks in the turns and shows its belly
Danger is above the back (spout) and right behind (tail slam). Move aside when you see the warning. The sides and below are safe
The head is a weak point (no more clouds). Breaking the tail stops the slam
